senses.sense_definition: A person who has suddenly risen to wealth or high social status but has not gained acceptance from those already in that class.

examples.text: The members of the exclusive club dismissed the newly wealthy businessman as a vulgar <w>parvenu</w>.
Although she amassed immense wealth through trade, high society always treated her like an unwelcome <w>parvenu</w>.

senses.sense_definition: Characteristic of or resembling someone who has newly risen to wealth or high status without possessing traditional refinement.

examples.text: Traditional aristocrats looked down upon the flashy, <w>parvenu</w> lifestyle of the industrial tycoons.
He decorated his enormous mansion with gaudy furniture that reflected his <w>parvenu</w> tastes.
